---
name: Feature request
about: A tool, option or behaviour the harness should have
labels: enhancement
---

**What you are trying to do**
The task or game, and where the current tools get in the way.

**What you would like**
The tool or option you have in mind, if any.

**Fair play**
The agent may only do what a person at the machine could (see "Fair play" in the README). If your idea gives the agent more than that, such as reading memory or pausing a realtime game, say why it is still fair, or whether it belongs behind an opt-in flag.
